The upper regions are through that entrance.[XENO:n ]
You gotta go through Makna Forest first.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Prison Island is at the Giant God's head,[XENO:n ]
just above Makna Forest.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]It pains me to say it, but this is[XENO:n ]
the point where I turn back.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I must see to the survivors, and I'm also[XENO:n ]
very concerned about Colony 9.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I understand. Thank you for everything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I might have said a few things[XENO:n ]
I shouldn't have back in the mine.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Forgive me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No, it's OK.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]I owe you my life, young man.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I'll never forget it, Heir to the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Medic, will you stay with them?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I want to help Shulk.[XENO:n ]
The Machine God Soldiers must pay for what they did.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]And I'm sure Gado is still alive somewhere.[XENO:n ]
If he is, I have to find him.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Find him, for me too. Good luck.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Carna, I want to go with Odama-san.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Are you sure?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I've never seen anything cooler than Shulk-san[XENO:n ]
smashing Machine God Soldiers with the Monado![XENO:wait wait=key ]
But I'm just slowing you down.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]No way, kid! You just need[XENO:n ]
to shape up like me![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]It's OK. I've made up my mind.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Compared to Shulk-san and the others, I know[XENO:n ]
I'm pretty useless.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But that's cool.[XENO:n ]
Because I know what I can do.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

I'm gonna go back to the colony and help[XENO:n ]
the survivors rebuild their lives.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You'll do us proud, kid.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Good luck, Juujuu.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Thanks![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Shulk, Rein. Keep Carna safe for me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Dikson-san, are you leaving too?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The Mechon may be gone from Colony 6 now,[XENO:n ]
but that doesn't mean we've seen the last of 'em.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

When they launch another attack, and they will,[XENO:n ]
Colony 9's gonna need my help.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah, I guess you're really needed at the colony.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
This ain't the last you'll see of me.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

You should be all right for now.[XENO:n ]
Look after the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You can bet on it![XENO:n ]
We won’t let the colony down.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You'll make us proud, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You, on the other hand, need to buck up your ideas![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]How else are you gonna protect Shulk?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Thanks for the heads-up, Dikson-san.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Good luck. See ya.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Can't say I feel so good about[XENO:n ]
deceiving these kids.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What's that you say?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Just mumbling. Forget I said anything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
